label: late original-phase f in r-initial sequences (after m)
explanation: Very sparse feature (162 of 1M sequences) that fires almost only in sequences whose first token is r (97% of activation mass). Within those, it fires late in the original phase (orig_idx 4-8, mostly the last 1-2 tokens before <DEL>), and mainly on input f (76% of mass), especially when an m appeared earlier, often immediately before. The largest activations are f right after m (e.g. r r 0 m m f, value 3.79). Weaker activations land on d or other tokens in the same position, and on <DEL> right after such a step (out_tok r). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<4. Precision is poor: most r...m...f sequences do not activate it, and no further history condition I tried (prev_tok m, a 0 seen earlier) made it cleaner. So this is only a rough description of a context it fires in, not a sharp trigger.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 25 cues. Raise it: orig0=r (+4.24), prev_tok=m (+2.63), orig1=r (+2.40), prev2_tok=m (+2.21), phase=0 & in_tok=f (+1.97), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=f (+1.97). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-1.90), orig_idx=-1 (-1.69), phase=2 (-1.47), next_out=- (-1.12).
